title: Looking for my people
content: Weaving together pieces of being a GATE kid, experiencing the Gateway Tapes , and weaving this experience through my lucid dreaming world. I’ve been trying to analyze my super intense lucid dreams for the better part of 15 years. Started using ChatGPT to help analyze and started realizing that a lot of pieces fit together that I didn’t even know are related. I saw a video somewhere talking about the “mall world” that we all go to. The comments talked about the movie theater too. So many people have the same experiences with their dreamworld that I do, but I can’t find my way to them in the Reddit world. I know you guys are out there looking for the others too. 🙏🏼
